title: Restricted derived tensor counit comparison under coefficient equivalences
statement: Let R0,A0,B0,C0 and R,A,B,C be commutative rings in one universe, with the two base algebra diagrams and tensor-algebra maps to C0 and C. Choose possibly distinct morphism universes for the two derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], input complexes Q0,Q and their base-derived tensor cohomology models M,N [def-pc-base-derived-tensor-cohomology-model]. Suppose eR,eA,eB are compatible coefficient ring equivalences, and q identifies Q0 with Q restricted along eA. Fix a tensor-ring equivalence eE sending a tensor b to eA(a) tensor eB(b), and fix an ordinary tensor chain isomorphism s sending r tensor x to eE(r) tensor q(x). In each degree i there is a B0-linear isomorphism kB from M.cohomology(i) restricted along includeRight to N.cohomology(i) restricted first along includeRight and then eB. It intertwines multiplication by a tensor 1 with multiplication by eA(a) tensor 1. On each element x, N.comparison applied to kB(x), followed by the inverse exact-restriction homology isomorphism along eE, equals homology(s) applied to M.comparison(x). This conclusion neither constructs eE or s nor asserts tensor-algebra linearity of kB; those are proved by the caller. No flatness, comparison invertibility, or compatibility of maps to C0,C is required.

source.place: Lemma 15.61.1, independence of derived tensor choices; coefficient-equivalence refinement, with localization uniqueness as in Stacks Section 13.11 (Tag 05RR).

proof.text: Build the natural restriction-composition isomorphism from hRA, and apply it termwise after restriction of q. This gives p:Q0_R0≅restriction_eR(Q_R). Its underlying components are q, so it intertwines multiplication by a with multiplication by eA(a).

Apply exists_derivedExtension_ringEquiv_cohomology to the universal derived functors and counits of M,N, obtaining t,d, their generator formula and counit square. Conjugate P0.mapIso(p) followed by d at Q_R by the model cohomologyIso maps to construct kB.

Apply P0 to the multiplication-intertwining equation for p, use naturality of d and both cohomologyIso_smul equations, and cancel the target cohomologyIso. Evaluate the resulting morphism equality to obtain the scalar-action identity.

Compose t at Q_R with ordinary scalar extension of p to obtain v. Its generator formula follows from extendScalars.map_tmul and that of t. Naturality of the first counit and of the derived/homotopy homology factorization maps combines the counit square for d with p. Apply baseDerivedTensor_ring_counit_square to this square and the conjugation identity for kB, giving the pointwise comparison identity.

proof_origin.place: Lemma 15.61.1, independence of choices; coefficient refinement of the original three proof steps.
proof_origin.note: Actual Lean construction and scalar-action proof, with ordinary-comparison bookkeeping proved separately. Only universal derived-counit transport is deferred, in its own strictly smaller node.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_baseDerivedTensor_restricted_ring_comparison
    {R₀ A₀ B₀ C₀ R A B C : Type u}
    [CommRing R₀] [CommRing A₀] [CommRing B₀] [CommRing C₀]
    [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [CommRing C]
    [Algebra R₀ A₀] [Algebra R₀ B₀] [Algebra (A₀ ⊗[R₀] B₀) C₀]
    [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B] [Algebra (A ⊗[R] B) C]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ModuleCat.{u} R₀)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ModuleCat.{u} B₀)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w'} (ModuleCat.{u} R)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w'} (ModuleCat.{u} B)]
    (Q₀ : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A₀) ℤ)
    (Q : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ)
    (M : BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R₀ A₀ B₀ Q₀ C₀)
    (N : BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B Q C)
    (eR : R₀ ≃+* R) (eA : A₀ ≃+* A) (eB : B₀ ≃+* B)
    (hRA : eA.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap R₀ A₀) =
      (algebraMap R A).comp eR.toRingHom)
    (hRB : eB.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap R₀ B₀) =
      (algebraMap R B).comp eR.toRingHom)
    (q : Q₀ ≅ ((restrictScalars.{u} eA.toRingHom).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q)
    (eE : (A₀ ⊗[R₀] B₀) ≃+* (A ⊗[R] B))
    (heE : ∀ (a : A₀) (b : B₀), eE (a ⊗ₜ[R₀] b) = eA a ⊗ₜ[R] eB b)
    (s : ((extendScalars (algebraMap A₀ (A₀ ⊗[R₀] B₀))).mapHomologicalComplex
        (.up ℤ)).obj Q₀ ≅
      ((restrictScalars.{u} eE.toRingHom).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
        (((extendScalars (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] B))).mapHomologicalComplex
          (.up ℤ)).obj Q))
    (hs : ∀ (j : ℤ) (r : A₀ ⊗[R₀] B₀) (x : Q₀.X j),
      s.hom.f j (r ⊗ₜ[A₀,algebraMap A₀ (A₀ ⊗[R₀] B₀)] x) =
        eE r ⊗ₜ[A,algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] B)] (show Q.X j from q.hom.f j x))
    (i : ℤ) :
    let K := ((extendScalars (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] B))).mapHomologicalComplex
      (.up ℤ)).obj Q
    ∃ kB : (restrictScalars.{u} Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom).obj
        (M.cohomology i) ≅
      (restrictScalars.{u} eB.toRingHom).obj
        ((restrictScalars.{u} Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom).obj
          (N.cohomology i)),
      (∀ (a : A₀) (x : M.cohomology i),
        kB.hom ((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft (S := R₀) a : A₀ ⊗[R₀] B₀) • x) =
          (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft (S := R) (eA a) : A ⊗[R] B) •
            (show N.cohomology i from kB.hom x)) ∧
      ∀ x : M.cohomology i,
        ((K.sc i).mapHomologyIso (restrictScalars.{u} eE.toRingHom)).inv
            (N.comparison i (show N.cohomology i from kB.hom x)) =
          HomologicalComplex.homologyMap s.hom i (M.comparison i x)
